_about: The embed gate's expected screens. A sign review is approved only on an exact match with one entry of signFaces (judge.mjs). A change to what TinyCloud One asks for, or to OpenKey's review copy, makes the gate fail closed until this file is updated in a reviewed change. Sources: the TinyCloud One sign-in face observed 2026-11-22 (QA fixture p2/x12, renewal and 30-day forms), OpenKey apps/web signing-approval.svelte, terms-accept.svelte (embed branch, kind first; release 2026-11-22). A title line given as an array accepts any one of its strings: the headline is "Authorize capabilities" on a released OpenKey web and "Sign in to <host>" on a web with the named sign-in heading (capability-review protocolHeadline; no signed manifest, so the host page's hostname).
